description: Header file defining a lock-free single-producer single-consumer queue (SPSCQueue) template class, including memory management, synchronization, and queue operations.

classes.name: rigtorp::SPSCQueue
classes.description: A lock-free, single-producer, single-consumer queue template class supporting concurrent enqueue and dequeue operations with memory ordering guarantees.

methods.name: SPSCQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the queue with specified capacity and optional allocator, managing memory allocation and alignment.

methods.name: ~SPSCQueue
methods.description: Destructor deallocating memory and cleaning up remaining elements.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs an element in-place at the tail of the queue with provided arguments.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to construct an element in-place; returns false if the queue is full.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Copies or moves an element into the queue.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element; returns false if the queue is full.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the front element if available, nullptr otherwise.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the front element from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements the queue can hold.
